events.verdict: Adebayo (MIA) jumps toward Queta (BOS) as he pursues the rebound and the contact is marginal.

Adebayo (MIA) gets his hand firmly on the ball during Brown's (BOS) drive to the basket and the contact is incidental. Brown jumps into the air and returns to the floor while Adebayo still has his hand on the ball and a held ball is whistled.
Wiggins (MIA) is moving alongside Brown's (BOS) path and absorbs the contact that occurs during the drive.
Vucevic (BOS) makes contact to the ball to deflect Powell's (MIA) pass.
Wiggins (MIA) and Vucevic (BOS) engage and disengage attempting to establish position in the post before the errant pass is thrown.
Wiggins (MIA) deflects the pass away from Vucevic (BOS).
White (BOS) legally contests Powell's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Powell (MIA) briefly has a hand placed around White (BOS) and immediately removes it as he moves off of the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Brown (BOS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. There is no clear and conclusive evidence to overturn the call on the floor that Brown extends his arm into Wiggins' (MIA) head/face, making more than marginal contact.
White (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during Mitchell's (MIA) drive to the basket and blocks his shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) and Brown (BOS) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Powell (MIA) legally contests White's (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Hauser (BOS) legally contests Mitchell's (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) deflects the ball away from Queta (BOS) during the rebound.
Pritchard (BOS) releases away from Smith (MIA) after the two players engage during the throw-in.
